summary.text: Scott Huffman is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 76, running against Republican Greg Edds in the November 3, 2026 general election for an open seat.
A U.S. Navy veteran who has worked in information technology and cyber security, he was the Democratic nominee for North Carolina's 8th Congressional District in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Scott Huffman was born in Salisbury, North Carolina, and graduated from North Rowan High School in 1980.
Huffman served in the U.S. Navy for more than seven years and reached the rank of petty officer 2nd class, and his professional experience includes information technology and cyber security.
He is affiliated with the Democratic Party of Mecklenburg County, served on the board of directors of the Elizabeth Hanford Dole American Red Cross, and was the founder of Indivisible Charlotte.
Huffman ran for U.S. House in North Carolina's 8th District in 2022, losing the general election to incumbent Dan Bishop, 69.9% to 30.1%.
